x-comment: LOCAL DEVELOPMENT manifest. Not a Flathub submission. A Flathub manifest must be written by a human and must not contain AI-generated or AI-assisted content.
x-comment-locales: Keep every translation in the app itself. A split .Locale extension only installs the system's languages, so the in-app language preference could not switch to any other.
x-comment-pkg-config-path: PKG_CONFIG_PATH gains /app/lib64/pkgconfig. flatpak-builder's own build env covers /app/lib/pkgconfig only, and it passes --libdir=/app/lib; a builder that does not pass that (as on some distro builds of flatpak-builder) leaves meson's platform default, which resolved to /app/lib64 in CI and put libspelling's .pc where pkg-config never looks. Covering both layouts costs nothing and keeps the build working whichever libdir the SDK ends up with.

modules.name: libspelling
modules.x-comment: Spell checking in the composer. The GNOME 51 runtime ships GtkSourceView 5 and enchant with hunspell dictionaries, but not libspelling.

modules.name: libpeas
modules.x-comment: Plugin discovery and loading (src/pluginhost.py). The GNOME 51 runtime does not ship libpeas. Only the Python loader is built: plugins are Python, and the GJS and Lua loaders would only add size.

modules.name: python-deps
modules.x-comment: Feed Chef: numpy (language scoring), py3langid (language ID), kmedoids (taste clusters) and segno (QR codes for sharing a recipe). Pinned wheels for the GNOME 51 runtime Python (3.14, cp314), installed from the files below with no network (the flatpak-pip-generator shape). The licences are recorded in Docs/third-party-notices.md.
build-commands: pip3 install --verbose --exists-action=i --no-index --no-deps --find-links="file://${PWD}" --prefix=${FLATPAK_DEST} --no-build-isolation numpy py3langid kmedoids segno
